description: Plan where to stop for fast charging on a drive between two places on a road Elton has a page for. Give the car as car and the temperature as temperatureC whenever the user says them, not a range of your own: Elton knows the car's range and cuts it for cold. When the drive ends at a cabin or anywhere the user can't charge, set noChargerAtDestination, and the plan makes sure the car gets back to a fast charger. Charges to 80% at each stop, as Elton advises, keeps a 20% reserve, and prefers stops with a place to eat or a food shop. A sketch: the Elton app shows which chargers are free. Its appUrl opens the whole drive, with the charging stops, in the Elton app's route planner.

arrivePercent.description: How full the battery should be on arrival, in percent (the 20% reserve if not given). For a cabin with no charger, set noChargerAtDestination instead.

car.description: The car, as "Hyundai Ioniq 5" or "Tesla Model Y Long Range": its range and the chargers it can fast-charge at come from Elton's list. Give it whenever the user names the car, rather than rangeKm.

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

food.description: Stop to charge where this place to eat or food shop is nearby, where one is in reach, as "Burger King".

from.description: Where the drive starts: a road page's end or a town along it, as "Oslo". In Norway also a street address or a place off the road, as the user said it ("Storgata 1, Hamar"): the plan starts at the town on a road nearest it, and its asked field says which.

noChargerAtDestination.description: True when there's no charger where the drive ends, as a cabin, or the user says they can't charge there: the plan arrives with enough to drive back to the fastest charger near the end, with a plan B, within the 80% rule, or says it can't.

rangeKm.description: How far the car goes on a full battery in mild weather, in km: only for a car that isn't in Elton's list, as car is better. Not a winter figure: temperatureC cuts the range for cold, so a winter figure would be cut twice.

startPercent.description: How full the battery is at the start, in percent (default 100).

temperatureC.description: The temperature on the drive, in °C. Below +10 the range is cut by an estimate from NAF and Motor's El Prix winter test.

to.description: Where it ends: a road page's end or a town along it, as "Trysil" or "Seljord". In Norway also a street address, as a cabin's ("Røvskroken 13, Beitostølen").
